old_problem: The authoritative expected result is contradictory: uncorrectable non-fatal normally describes severity/containment, yet the Criteria requires shutdown/restart without policy or timing; the target address and profile are also unbound.
disposition_reason: A safe address/profile can be parameterized, but ED-15 cannot supply an authoritative PASS oracle when service preservation and mandatory restart are both plausible and mutually exclusive. ED-16 also requires the expected containment to select the correct recovery. This project policy is not derivable from generic AMD/APEI behavior, so the row remains Pending/BLOCKED until the platform owner defines disposition and deadlines.

test_case.test_name: AMD DRAM uncorrectable non-fatal event per slot
test_case.purpose: For each populated memory slot, inject one attributable errortype1 UCE and verify the platform-approved non-fatal containment disposition plus complete memory/system recovery.
required_package: Per-slot UMC/rank topology and safe decoded pinned page
DRAM/MCA profile applicability and AMD tool contract
Authoritative preserve-service versus shutdown/restart policy with deadlines
OOB recovery, persistent-poison cleanup and full restoration
test_case.test_command: Do not inject until the disposition is approved. Then run one mapped slot/profile checkpoint under FAE and continuous OOB observation, correlate exact UCE attribution, compare service/restart behavior with the signed policy, recover and clear residual poison through the approved method, restore state, and separately authorize the next slot.
test_case.expected_result: The intended slot records the specified non-fatal UCE and follows exactly the approved service-preservation or bounded restart path, after which memory integrity and platform health return to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS exists until the owner decides the disposition and timing. Tool PASS, generic UCE text, an unexplained restart, survival when restart is required, or restart when service must remain cannot pass.
safety_gate: Backed-up isolated ECC SUT with OOB console and recovery.
No unmapped address, cumulative profile or undefined disposition.
One slot only; abort on wrong slot, fatal escalation, restart loop, persistent poison or no boot.
Never auto-reset, retry or advance coverage.
expected_evidence: Versioned disposition decision and slot/page map
Per-slot UCE and exact service/restart observation
Poison cleanup, memory integrity, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: Recovery depends on the unresolved service-versus-restart policy and persistent-poison behavior. The platform owner must supply an OOB sequence and deadlines before this destructive case can execute.
